We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account with our agency, Keystone Account Solutions. We understand that you are disputing the debt as allegedly already paid. We will investigate this matter in accordance with the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and Wyoming state law.

Our records indicate that the original creditor for this account is Sunrise Health Partners, and the current balance is $4,670.36. We also note that the charge-off date for this account is April 27, 2023, and the last payment date was May 12, 2024.

We will investigate your claim that the debt was paid. If our investigation confirms that the debt was indeed paid, we will take the necessary steps to update our records and ensure that any further collection activities cease. However, if our investigation does not confirm that the debt was paid, we will continue to pursue collection of the debt.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe that our investigation was incomplete or inaccurate. You may also request validation of the debt, which we will provide if requested.

We appreciate your cooperation in this matter and will keep you informed of any developments.

Sincerely,
